periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical/oblique orientation, tilted approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high height-to-width ratio, approximately 2.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest boundary extending significantly further from the centroid than the dorsal boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve profile at the posterior edge of the band across the shoulders.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderate thickness, occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semi-circular apex with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-tan pigmentation across the lumbar and hindquarter regions, contrasting with the white cranial and thoracic pelage.
